customManagers.description: Update Dockerfile ARG versions annotated with a preceding '# renovate: datasource=<datasource> depName=<depName>' comment, e.g. unbound. A packageName after the depName keeps a long lookup path out of the commit subject.

packageRules.description: Unbound tags releases as release-<major>.<minor>.<patch>. Release candidates are tagged but never published as GitHub releases, so only final releases are proposed.
